threadDescriptions.estate-deliveries: Arrange food-bank home deliveries to the Cedar estate
threadDescriptions.donor-report: Report monthly food-bank distribution totals to donors
threadDescriptions.collection-drive: Run the workplace food collection drive
threadDescriptions.porch-planter: Build a planter for my porch
threadDescriptions.van-cleaning: Remove a spill and odour from the food-bank van

items.text: Cedar estate delivery route: six stops on Wednesday. Mrs Vale needs the parcel left with the caretaker if her bell goes unanswered.
items.rationale: Specific home-delivery logistics.

items.text: Monthly donor update draft says 214 parcels distributed. Verify the home-delivery tally before sending the chart.
items.rationale: Aggregate reporting deliverable; no change to delivery operations.

items.text: Porch planter cut list: two long sides at 90 cm, four corner blocks. Use the leftover exterior screws.
items.rationale: Home woodworking project.

items.text: A juice carton burst in the food-bank van. Remove the rubber floor mat and wash underneath; leaving perfume in there won't fix it.
items.rationale: Vehicle cleaning task.

items.text: Workplace collection drive poster: unopened tins and dry staples. Drop boxes in both staff kitchens until the 18th.
items.rationale: Promotes the workplace donation campaign.

items.text: Door 214 at Cedar has no working intercom. Driver should call the caretaker on arrival; the contact is in the protected route sheet.
items.rationale: Stop access detail; 214 is a door number, not report total.

items.text: The monthly donor draft overstated distributions: 214 included 12 parcels still awaiting pickup. Replace the headline with 202 delivered and show the 12 pending separately.
items.rationale: Corrects the earlier donor-report statistic.

items.text: Van mat drying over the rail. Sticky patch under the seat remains; use a small brush around the bolts.
items.rationale: Progress on removing the vehicle spill.

items.text: For the porch box, drill drainage holes before fixing the base. The liner must not block them.
items.rationale: Construction details for the planter.

items.text: Cedar route and donor closeout: log each successful doorstep handover in the route sheet; send only the anonymous count to the monthly report. Two unanswered doors remain on Thursday's retry list and must not count as delivered yet.
items.rationale: Directs delivery retries and defines the resulting reporting count.

items.text: Did we include the extra twelve? The total looks odd.
items.rationale: No object or document identifies which total is meant.

items.text: Collection boxes are half full. Ask the workplace host to add lentils to the poster; we have more pasta than the shelves can take.
items.rationale: Adjusts requested donations during the workplace drive.

items.text: Food-bank van smells clean after drying overnight. Refit the mat only once the underside is dry.
items.rationale: Final drying and reassembly of the cleaned van.

items.text: Cedar driver checklist: count six loaded parcels, check lift access, return any undelivered bags to intake. Never leave food in a hallway without an agreed recipient.
items.rationale: Delivery operating checklist.

items.text: Workplace drive finished with 63 kg. Sort dented tins for inspection and send the weighed total to the donor report editor; the thank-you paragraph should credit both staff kitchens without listing individual donors.
items.rationale: Closes the collection operation and supplies specific donor-report content.

items.text: Green one on top, please. It leaks less that way.
items.rationale: Unidentified object with no reliable project connection.

items.text: Porch planter lined and filled. Mint gets its own inner pot so the roots don't take over the thyme.
items.rationale: Completes planting in the constructed box.

items.text: The donor PDF now shows delivered, pending, and donated weight as distinct measures. Caption under the chart says parcels, not households.
items.rationale: Reviews presentation of the monthly report.

items.text: Caretaker accepted Mrs Vale's parcel and signed the Cedar sheet. The two retry stops both answered today.
items.rationale: Records completion of estate delivery stops.

items.text: Put the workplace drop boxes back in storage. One bottom needs tape before the next collection drive.
items.rationale: Equipment closeout from the donation campaign.

undo.reason: Hypothetical correction: 214 identifies an estate door; it does not report parcel volume.
